name: instantdelay
description: Change your Twitch/YouTube/Kick stream delay live, without restarting OBS. A local RTMP delay proxy with a delay screen, clips, an OBS dock, overlay and Stream Deck API. No dependencies.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rtmp && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/delay.test.js test/hold.test.js test/rtmp-unit.test.js test/png.test.js test/h264.test.js test/obsws.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: node test/e2e.js && OUTPUT=rtmp node test/e2e.js && TRANSPORT=ffmpeg node test/e2e.js
